title: Learning with a Single Rollout via Pass@k Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2606.25451v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) typically requires multiple rollouts per prompt to estimate relative credit, incurring substantial sampling cost and exacerbating training asynchrony. This limitation is particularly severe for scientific reasoning agents, where each trajectory may involve long-horizon reasoning, multiple turns, and parallel sub-runs. We study single-rollout reinforcement learning, where only one rollout is collected per prompt, and find that naive training can stagnate or become severely unstable. We introduce Single-Rollout Pass@k Policy Optimization (SR-PPO), which combines Monte Carlo token-level advantage estimation with Pass@k gradient reweighting. An online critic without large-scale pretraining is used both as a prefix-dependent baseline for credit assignment and to estimate the Pass@k gradient weight. Using only one rollout per prompt, SR-PPO achieves stable learning and performance comparable

translated_title: 通过Pass@k策略优化实现单次采样学习
translated_abstract: 群相对策略优化（GRPO）通常需要每个提示进行多次采样来估计相对信用，这会带来巨大的采样成本并加剧训练的异步性。这一限制对于科学推理智能体来说尤为严重，因为每条轨迹可能涉及长程推理、多轮交互和并行子运行。我们研究单次采样强化学习，即每个提示仅收集一次采样轨迹，并发现朴素的训练方式可能会停滞或变得严重不稳定。我们提出了单次采样Pass@k策略优化（SR-PPO），它将蒙特卡洛token级优势估计与Pass@k梯度重加权相结合。一个无需大规模预训练的在线评论家网络既被用作前缀相关的基线来进行信用分配，也被用于估计Pass@k梯度权重。每个提示仅使用一次采样，SR-PPO就实现了稳定的学习和可比的性能。
tldr: 提出SR-PPO方法，通过将蒙特卡洛token级优势估计与Pass@k梯度重加权相结合，并利用在线评论家网络同时充当信用分配基线和梯度权重估计器，实现每个提示仅需单次采样即可稳定训练，大幅降低了GRPO等方法的高昂采样成本。
en_tdlr: SR-PPO enables stable reinforcement learning with only a single rollout per prompt by combining Monte Carlo token-level advantage estimation with Pass@k gradient reweighting, using an online critic for both credit assignment baseline and weight estimation, thereby drastically reducing the substantial sampling costs of GRPO.
